description:
There are only two options.
Do what’s hard now so life can be easier later.
Or avoid the hard now and spend your future paying for it.

No one escapes the trade-off, but the choice is always yours.
transcript: If you live life the hard way, it's easy. And if you live life the easy way, it's hard. And here's what I equate that to. We have to pick our pain. Think about that.
spoken_hook_0_3s: If you live life the hard way, it's easy.
